adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the DB is mutated first via `prisma.booking.update(... createMany ...)` (lines ~92-106). After that, `await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking);` is executed with no surrounding try/catch (line ~165). If calendar sync throws, the mutation will error back to the client even though attendees were already persisted, causing a user-visible failure toast in AddGuestsDialog `onError` while guests are actually added. Because the exception would short-circuit the function, the subsequent `sendAddGuestsEmails` block would be skipped entirely as well.
